419:t_1:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, I'd be startled too if a super-dimensional life-form suddenly appeared...」

419:t_1:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But abandoning your post over it was a bad idea, Mr. $$ギルター$$.」

419:t_1:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Our boss is rather furious about that, you see.」

419:t_1:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Wh-what should I do!? Tell me, $$サルディアス$$...!」

419:t_1:10.en:
$$ギルター$$
「No! Please tell me, Lord $$サルディアス$$!」

419:t_1:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... With all your previous failures added in, I'd say you're down for the count. I can't see a way back for you...」

419:t_1:12.en:
$$ギルター$$
「P-please find some way...! I don't want to be reduced to an $$アンタレス$$!」

419:t_1:13.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...Will you do anything?」

419:t_1:15.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If you're that determined, I'll lend you something special. Used properly, it should unleash tremendous power.」

419:t_1:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If you use it to bury $c, the boss might forgive you.」

419:t_1:17.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Thank you! Thank you, Lord $$サルディアス$$!」

419:t_1:18.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Now then, Mr. $$ギルター$$... Can you master it?)

419:t_1:27.en:
$n
「Are you interested in $$ジークンドー$$?」

419:t_1:28.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ベローズ$$ told me to get in shape.」

419:t_1:29.en:
$n
「I agree. If you live with the fleet, you'll probably be doing mostly physical work.」

419:t_1:30.en:
$n
「If you're thinking of returning to the fleet someday, start building up your strength now.」

419:t_1:32.en:
$n
「It looks like you've gotten a little more tan.」

419:t_1:33.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ベベル$$ said that too. It's from helping with the fishing these past few days. I learned just how little stamina I have.」

419:t_1:34.en:
$n
「We're staying with the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ until they've finished admitting $$クーゲル$$'s fleet and $$ラケージ$$'s pirates.」

419:t_1:35.en:
$n
「While you're here, try different things and see what you can do.」

419:t_1:36.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$ recommended that too.」

419:t_1:37.en:
$n
「He's become a system for supporting your whole life, $$レド$$, more than just your piloting...」

419:t_1:38.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm as grateful to $$チェインバー#pilot$$ as I am to $$エイミー$$.」

419:t_1:39.en:
$n
「...Hey, $$レド$$... Can I ask you something?」

419:t_1:41.en:
$n
「You lived for your mission as a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$. I want to ask about when you decided to give it up.」

419:t_1:43.en:
$n
「They were complete opposites, but both mattered deeply to you. Tell me how you felt when you got past that and made your choice.」

419:t_1:44.en:
$$レド$$
「...I've never even thought about how my feelings changed.」

419:t_1:45.en:
$$レド$$
「But when the time came, I naturally moved toward what I truly wanted.」

419:t_1:47.en:
$n
「Thanks, $$レド$$. This isn't exactly repayment, but want me to teach you $$ジークンドー$$?」

419:t_1:51.en:
$$メール$$
「Yeah. Darling says he needs you.」

419:t_1:52.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ランド$$ needs me? What does he need me for?」

419:t_1:53.en:
$$メール$$
「You'll find out when we get there. Come on... Let's-a-go!」

419:t_1:56.en:
$$ティティ$$
「$$ランド$$ and $$ピニオン$$ say they're going to train $$レド$$.」

419:t_1:57.en:
$n
「Train him... Do you mean smile training?」

419:t_1:58.en:
$$ティティ$$
「What's that? It sounds fun!」

419:t_1:59.en:
$n
「$$ランド$$ put me through that training too.」

419:t_1:60.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So that's why you've got such a nice smile, $n.」

419:t_1:64.en:
$n
(I'd better not ask about her family... Everyone has their own circumstances...)

419:t_1:65.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I don't like it when you bring something up yourself and then leave me hanging.」

419:t_1:67.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Then I'll ask you something hard to answer instead.」

419:t_1:69.en:
$n
「She's my partner. She was also my teacher when I went to school. That's why I call her that.」

419:t_1:70.en:
$$ティティ$$
「That isn't what I want to know. I mean, what's her relationship with you, $n?」

419:t_1:71.en:
$n
「Our relationship...? We're partners in battle, and teacher and student the rest of the time...」

419:t_1:72.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I don't want to hear you dodge the question like that.」

419:t_1:74.en:
$$ティティ$$
「$$甲児$$, $$カレン$$, and $$アルト$$ all said I'd have to ask you for anything more...」

419:t_1:77.en:
$n
「...No, she isn't. Besides, I had someone else like that.」

419:t_1:80.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Did you two just drift apart?」

419:t_1:82.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Then maybe I should put myself forward... as your girlfriend, $n.」

419:t_1:84.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Don't look so shocked. ...Don't you think that would be fun?」

419:t_1:85.en:
$n
「...I'm sorry... I'm not in a position to think about that right now.」
